methodology.isolation: Fresh TemporaryDirectory under /tmp, dedicated SQLite DB; inherited RTRS_* settings removed; ephemeral ports; no production DB
methodology.transport: Actual server subprocess and localhost HTTP/HTTPS sockets; no mocks
methodology.load: 20 search + 20 two-passenger bookings, separately, four concurrent clients, fresh connection per request, nearest-rank p90 <3 seconds each; connection through full response latency
methodology.recovery: Controlled restart and abrupt process kill/relaunch after committed writes, same database plus read-only SQLite integrity check; not power-loss or interrupted-transaction durability
methodology.credentials: Random runtime password; request bodies and auth headers never logged by runner; response secrets redacted
limits: Small local load only; no sustained stress or internet latency conclusions
TLS uses a temporary self-signed trust anchor; does not validate production certificates
Admin audit API records booking events; train changes verified via read-back and restart
No UI, screenshot, coverage or unit-test results claimed by this independent runner
